source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Tournament organisers have several ways to pair Singles players and set standings. Matching players with equivalent records is a starting point. The following Games Workshop practices offer ways to keep the event fair and enjoyable at every level of the standings.

detail.recommendations: practices used at most Games Workshop events
